content.text: I will run the init script if present, change to ~/test, compute the two counts, and print their product.

arguments: {"script":"test -f ~/init && . ~/init || true; cd ~/test && a=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 ! -name '.*' | wc -l); b=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.txt' -size +0c | wc -l); echo $((a*b))"}
